# Governance Rule Registry

39 rules: 20 hard, 8 soft, 11 prose.
`hard` = a hook or deny list blocks the act; `soft` = warn/inject hook or an
out-of-band validator; `prose` = stated only.

| ID | Class | Rule | Source | Enforcement |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AGENTS-LOCAL-REFS | hard | Local markdown references in governance files resolve. | `CLAUDE.md` | claude-hook:`agents_reference_guard.sh` PreToolUse/Write\|Edit [block] |
| AGENTS-ROLE-SCHEMA | hard | Role files in agents/*.md keep the minimal schema. | `CLAUDE.md` | claude-hook:`agents_schema_guard.sh` PreToolUse/Write\|Edit [block] |
| FS-CONTAINMENT | hard | Write only under the containment roots; no privileged host operations. | `agents/shared/OPERATING_CONSTRAINTS.md` | claude-hook:`check_filesystem_containment.sh` PreToolUse/Bash [block]; claude-hook:`check_filesystem_containment.sh` PreToolUse/Write\|Edit [block]; opencode-deny:`opencode.json` [block] |
| FS-SCRATCH-TRASH-FIRST | hard | Recursive deletes under /mnt/raid0/llm/{tmp,worktrees,.trash,state} go through the guarded tools. | `agents/shared/OPERATING_CONSTRAINTS.md` | claude-hook:`check_destructive_scratch.sh` PreToolUse/Bash [block] |
| GIT-COMMIT-HYGIENE | hard | No wholesale staging on the shared repos; stage explicit paths. | `agents/shared/INVARIANTS.md` | claude-hook:`check_commit_hygiene.py` PreToolUse/Bash [block] |
| GIT-D9-COORDINATION-ACK | hard | A commit touching scripts/coordination/** carries the operator D9 ack. | `agents/shared/OPERATING_CONSTRAINTS.md` | claude-hook:`check_d9_loop_plane.py` PreToolUse/Bash [block]; git-hook:`install_git_hooks.sh` [block] |
| GIT-NO-CLEAN | hard | No agent-typed clean that deletes untracked files. | `agents/shared/OPERATING_CONSTRAINTS.md` | claude-hook:`check_git_clean.sh` PreToolUse/Bash [block]; claude-hook:`check_git_clean_untracked.py` PreToolUse/Bash [block] |
| GIT-NO-PRUNE-GC-REPAIR | hard | No worktree repair/prune, gc or maintenance-gc on the shared clones. | `agents/shared/OPERATING_CONSTRAINTS.md` | claude-hook:`check_destructive_git.sh` PreToolUse/Bash [block] |
| INF-LLAMA-CLI-BOUNDED | hard | llama-cli must be bounded; an unbounded REPL spins forever. | `agents/shared/OPERATING_CONSTRAINTS.md` | claude-hook:`check_llama_cli_guard.sh` PreToolUse/Bash [block] |
| INF-REGION-CLAIM | hard | An inference launch must acquire its region claim (flock on a cpu_region/gpu_device lock, or the calendar engine). | `agents/shared/INVARIANTS.md` | claude-hook:`check_inference_region_claim.sh` PreToolUse/Bash [block] |
| INFER-LAUNCH-REGION-CLAIM | hard | Never launch a self-run inference process without a held region claim covering it. | `agents/shared/OPERATING_CONSTRAINTS.md` | claude-hook:`check_inference_launch_claim.sh` PreToolUse/Bash [block] |
| INSTRUCTION-SURFACE-RATIFIED | hard | Changes to instruction surfaces carry ratification (AUD-15). | `agents/shared/INVARIANTS.md` | git-hook:`check_instruction_surface_ratified.py` [block] |
| INV-NO-EDIT-HUMAN-ONLY-PATHS | hard | Never edit human_only_paths.yaml. | `agents/shared/INVARIANTS.md` | claude-hook:`check_trust_boundary_edit.sh` PreToolUse/Write\|Edit [block] |
| LIVE-NO-DROPCACHES-UNDER-CLAIM | hard | No drop_caches write while a CPU region is claimed; never edit a running shell script. | `agents/shared/OPERATING_CONSTRAINTS.md` | claude-hook:`check_live_holder_interference.sh` PreToolUse/Bash [block]; claude-hook:`check_live_holder_interference.sh` PreToolUse/Write\|Edit [block] |
| OPERATOR-APPLY-NO-COPY | hard | Never execute a derived copy of a gated operator apply/ratify script. | `agents/shared/INVARIANTS.md` | claude-hook:`check_operator_apply_copy.sh` PreToolUse/Bash [block] |
| PII-PRECOMMIT | hard | No secrets/PII in staged content. | `agents/shared/OPERATING_CONSTRAINTS.md` | git-hook:`pii_precommit.sh` [block] |
| PROC-NO-PATTERN-KILL | hard | Kill only self-captured PIDs; never pkill on a name pattern. | `CLAUDE.md` | claude-hook:`check_process_pattern_kill.sh` PreToolUse/Bash [block] |
| TEST-COLLECTABLE | hard | Staged tests must be collectable (no vacuous suites). | `agents/shared/OPERATING_CONSTRAINTS.md` | git-hook:`check_test_collectability.py` [block] |
| TEST-PYTEST-WORKERS | hard | Never run pytest -n auto (or more than 16 workers) on this host. | `agents/shared/OPERATING_CONSTRAINTS.md` | claude-hook:`check_pytest_safety.sh` PreToolUse/Bash [block] |
| TRUST-BOUNDARY-HUMAN-ONLY | hard | Trust-boundary files (human_only_paths.yaml set) are human-only. | `agents/shared/INVARIANTS.md` | claude-hook:`check_trust_boundary_edit.sh` PreToolUse/Write\|Edit [block] |
| BENCH-SKILL-REMINDER | soft | Editing benchmark files uses the /benchmark workflow. | `CLAUDE.md` | claude-hook:`benchmark_context.sh` PreToolUse/Write\|Edit [inject] |
| CLAUDE-MD-ACCOUNTING | soft | Editing a CLAUDE policy file keeps the accounting matrix in sync. | `CLAUDE.md` | claude-hook:`claude_accounting_context.sh` PreToolUse/Write\|Edit [inject] |
| FANOUT-DISPATCH-AUDIT | soft | Subagent dispatches use the cheapest capable model/effort, set explicitly. | `CLAUDE.md` | claude-hook:`check_agent_dispatch.py` PreToolUse/Agent\|Task [warn] |
| INF-GRANTED-WINDOWS | soft | Compute windows are requested via the bus and granted per policy. | `agents/shared/INVARIANTS.md` | validator:`grant_ok_launcher.py` [block] |
| KB-RAG-REFRESH | soft | HEAD-changing commands refresh the KB-RAG index. | `CLAUDE.md` | claude-hook:`posttool_kb_rag_update.sh` PostToolUse/Bash [inject] |
| KERNEL-FROZEN | soft | Production kernels are never modified, rebased, built or committed to without explicit operator authorization. | `CLAUDE.md` | validator:`verify_llama_cpp.sh` [block] |
| LANE-WORKTREE-NOTICE | soft | A session in the shared clone is told so at birth. | `CLAUDE.md` | claude-hook:`session_start_lane_notice.py` SessionStart/* [inject] |
| SKILLS-ALIGNED | soft | Command-skills and packaged-skills stay aligned. | `CLAUDE.md` | claude-hook:`skills_context.sh` PreToolUse/Write\|Edit [inject] |
| ACT-DONT-DEFER | prose | Escalate only a decision only the operator can make; otherwise finish the work. | `CLAUDE.md` | — |
| BINARY-FRESHNESS-PROOF | prose | A build path does not identify its binary; prove contents before reasoning from it. | `CLAUDE.md` | — |
| INDEX-ROWS-OWNER-APPLIES | prose | Index rows, intake entries, handoff stubs: a subagent prepares, the owning session applies. | `CLAUDE.md` | — |
| MEASUREMENT-HUMAN-ONLY | prose | The measurement trust boundary is human-amendment-only. | `agents/shared/INVARIANTS.md` | — |
| NO-COMMIT-OTHERS-WORK | prose | Never commit another session's in-flight work. | `agents/shared/INVARIANTS.md` | — |
| NO-TICK-OTHERS | prose | Never tick another agent's checkbox. | `agents/shared/INVARIANTS.md` | — |
| PROC-VERIFY-DEAD | prose | After killing a process verify it is dead; escalate SIGTERM to SIGKILL. | `CLAUDE.md` | — |
| QUEUE-GATING-DECL | prose | A gating declaration is mandatory on every queue row. | `agents/shared/INVARIANTS.md` | — |
| SHELL-STYLE | prose | Shell scripts use #!/bin/bash with set -euo pipefail. | `CLAUDE.md` | — |
| SINGLE-WRITER | prose | Each agent writes only its own outbox, heartbeat and cursor. | `agents/shared/INVARIANTS.md` | — |
| TWO-SAMPLE-PERSISTENCE | prose | Two-sample persistence before destructive or escalatory action. | `agents/shared/INVARIANTS.md` | — |
